gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-mayan-: Bushcraft draws every curve like a marker line, with capitals that barely rise above the lowercase and letters spaced far apart. And Noto Sans Mayan Numerals answers its closed shapes with sans-serif letters that gape open, giving the page a firmer footing.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-medefa: Noto Sans Medefaidrin reads crisp and upright, its lowercase climbing high and its curves turning in without any blobs of ink. Bushcraft's smooth wire-like line sits above it.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-mende-: Light, open, and a little stark: Noto Sans Mende Kikakui lets daylight through every curve, with lowercase that towers over its capitals. Over a long stretch it stays crisp.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-mono: Noto Sans Mono spaces its letters generously and lifts its lowercase high. Bushcraft is best at being a single marker-like line with closed shapes and no thick-to-thin shading, while the sans body does its best work opening every curve wide.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-mro: Noto Sans Mro packs its words dense and lofty through the middle, with generous entrances into each letter's inner space. Bushcraft's marker-like line suits large, brief lines.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-nabata: Marker-line looseness meets near-capital lowercase here. Bushcraft does its best work as a smooth, closed-shape display line with wide spacing, while Noto Sans Nabataean brings plain sans clarity and wide-open s curves.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-newa: Bushcraft draws its letters in one unshaded line, closed and widely spaced, with capitals that hardly stand apart from the lowercase. Noto Sans Newa is the opposite number: its lowercase e opens its mouth wide, and the clash is the pair's best quality.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Expressive and markerlike, Bushcraft keeps a constant-width line across every curve, while Noto Sans Ogham has a bold look from its lofty bodies. That clash of closed and open is the strength.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-old-no: Neutral and approachable, Noto Sans Old North Arabian sets a dense lowercase band, with terminals pointing outward like tongs. Bushcraft, shrunk small, would lose its wide-spaced marker-like presence, and a large body would crowd it out.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-old-pe: No weight shift anywhere along a curve: that is Bushcraft's signature, with capitals barely standing out and wide spacing between characters. Noto Sans Old Persian answers it with open counters that breathe.
